scientific_integrity: The claimed contribution is the explicit two-term mixed covariance, the true correlation rate and the phase variation, not established finite recurrence formulas. Independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Unrestricted uniformly distributed compositions only. The absolute o(1) remainder is established analytically through uniform differentiated poles and tail bounds; numerical checks are finite corroboration. The full text of Lou (1996) was inaccessible, so priority relative to a possibly implicit historical asymptotic theorem is unresolved. Periodic modulation is very small.
title: A two-term log-periodic covariance law for the largest part of a random composition
